dataset_release.purpose: A versioned/retrieved release of a Dataset.

transformation_run.purpose: Auditable ingestion/transformation execution represented as provenance activity.

source_record.purpose: Row-level admitted source record with deterministic content fingerprint and optional transformation provenance.

geography.purpose: Canonical geographic feature store, including supported country/administrative-region types and PostGIS geometry.
geography.provenance: Canonical geography used by provenance-linked observations and facilities.

geography_alias.purpose: Source-system geographic aliases and auditable normalization/resolution decisions.
geography_alias.provenance: Records source alias, resolution method, confidence and optional SourceRecord.

regulatory_jurisdiction.purpose: Regulatory jurisdiction kept semantically distinct from physical geography.
regulatory_jurisdiction.provenance: No dedicated source-record FK; provenance follows linked ingestion/mapping context.

organization.provenance: Canonical entity; source provenance follows identifiers/assertions/mappings where created.

facility.purpose: Canonical physical/operational facility identity with optional physical geography.
facility.provenance: Canonical entity; source provenance follows identifiers/observations/mappings where created.

facility_operation.purpose: Associative/relator table linking an Organization and Facility with optional validity interval.
facility_operation.provenance: Temporal relational implementation; no direct source-record FK.

pharmaceutical_substance.provenance: Source-normalized identity layer; strong identity claims remain bounded by mapping evidence.

medicinal_product.purpose: Canonical medicinal-product identity with a bounded primary-substance implementation hook.
medicinal_product.provenance: Source-normalized identity with mapping/evidence trace through downstream assertions and records.

product_presentation.purpose: Presentation/package-level medicinal-product identity and retained source presentation attributes.
product_presentation.provenance: Source-derived presentation identity used by identifiers and observations.

identifier_scheme.provenance: Scheme metadata; assignment provenance is stored in identifier_assignment.

identifier_assignment.purpose: Scheme-scoped identifier assignment to a supported canonical entity; identifier value is not entity identity.
identifier_assignment.provenance: Optional SourceRecord provenance for identifier assignment.

product_classification_scheme.provenance: Scheme metadata; assignment provenance is stored separately.

classification_entry.purpose: Code/label entry within a product-classification scheme.
classification_entry.provenance: Classification vocabulary entry; source-specific assignment provenance is separate.

product_classification_assignment.purpose: Provenance-aware assignment of a medicinal product to a classification entry.
product_classification_assignment.provenance: Optional SourceRecord provenance for classification assignment.

diagnosis_reference.purpose: Diagnosis-classification reference retained for market-access/reimbursement observations.

assertion.provenance: Evidence target linked to SourceRecord through evidence_support and observations.

evidence_support.purpose: Relator linking a SourceRecord to an Assertion.
evidence_support.provenance: Direct evidence relation between SourceRecord and Assertion.

observation_result.purpose: Aggregate observation/result representation used by implemented source adapters; includes provenance and contextual hooks.

entity_match_assertion.purpose: Auditable cross-source match assertion with method, confidence and disposition.
entity_match_assertion.provenance: Match provenance via two SourceRecord references.

medicine_shortage_situation.purpose: Contextual medicine-shortage situation linked to product/presentation/jurisdiction and optional source provenance.
